notes.subject: ולמרבכת
notes.rationale: rarotok: 'samting ol i pulim olgeta (long oil)' — ol tanim tok i no save wankain: 'fried' (KJV) vs 'soaked' (ASV/JPS).

notes.subject: משורה
notes.rationale: tok bilong mak bilong skelim wara — em wanpela ples tasol long Tanakh.

notes.subject: משורה ומדה
notes.rationale: ves i tok long ol mak bilong skelim — wok bilong ol Levi i lukautim olgeta skelim.

translation: Na long bret bilong ol row, na long flawa bilong minkha, na long ol thinkek bilong bret nomo yis, na long ol samting ol i kukim long pen, na long ol samting ol i pulim olgeta long oil, na long olgeta mak bilong skelim wara na mak bilong skelim kaikai;

tokens.gloss: na long ol samting ol i kukim long pen
na long ol samting ol i pulim olgeta long oil
